explication: This repository is a collection of TVBox/FongMi/CatVod configuration resources and site adapters, not a standalone media player. A user selects a source in a compatible host app; the host runs an adapter to search or browse a catalog, obtain detail and playback links, and pass them to playback. The tree also contains live, audio, and cloud-drive adapters, plus shared runtimes and helpers. The README documents several configuration variants; their JSON files are not in the supplied tree. Some source excerpts are partial or obfuscated, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
